nameStory.text: Day 21, around a campfire near Lake Geneva ferry. A section hiker whose name I never got said "Boots" and everyone laughed. I didn't get the joke, but it stuck.
Day 8, around a campfire near Mont Sainte-Odile. A section hiker whose name I never got said "Ghost" and everyone laughed. I didn't get the joke, but it stuck.
I stop for every view, every flower and every lizard. Near mile 108, Simon passed me for the third time that day and named me "Sauntero".
Did 33 miles one day before mile 464. A section hiker whose name I never got rolled into camp hours after me and announced I was "Rocket" now.
Day 17, around a campfire near La Dôle. Anna said "Goat" and everyone laughed. I didn't get the joke, but it stuck.
I stop for every view, every flower and every lizard. Near mile 310, a section hiker whose name I never got passed me for the third time that day and named me "Sloth".
Near mile 358 I followed a cow path for two miles before noticing the trail was gone. A section hiker whose name I never got found me and has called me "Mapquest" since.
Day 15, around a campfire near mile 298. A section hiker whose name I never got said "Cricket" and everyone laughed. I didn't get the joke, but it stuck.

I know everyone: water caches, trail magic, hiker boxes. Near Grand Ballon, Camille said I'd hugged more people than I'd hiked miles. "Social Butterfly" it is.
Day 4, near mile 54. Mike watched me hobble into camp nursing my it band and said "Limpy". The whole camp agreed, and that was that.
In Thonon-les-Bains, on my third zero, I ordered so much food the waitress asked if anyone was joining me. A section hiker whose name I never got has called me "Pop-Tart" ever since.
